name: Ōi (Fukui, Japan, –2006)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Ōi town emblem in white: an outlined ring with three pointed rays enclosing a three-armed device.
history: Flag of the former town of Ōi in Fukui Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-03-03.

features.role: Ōi town emblem — an outlined ring with three pointed rays enclosing a three-armed device
